findings.current: If I’d met the attack head-on, it would have cost me a considerable amount of strength just to stop it.
findings.defect: Changes an immediate counterattack into merely stopping the attack.
findings.rationale: 맞받아치다 specifies striking back, not just blocking or stopping.
findings.replacement: If I’d counterattacked at once, even that would have cost me a considerable amount of strength.
findings.source: 만약 곧바로 맞받아치는 것으로 대응했다면, 그것만으로도 분명 상당한 힘이 소모되었을 테니까.

findings.current: A brilliant flash enveloped an area more than ten *jang* across.
findings.defect: Turns a radius of more than ten jang into a total width of more than ten jang.
findings.replacement: A brilliant flash enveloped everything within a radius of more than ten *jang*.
findings.source: 휘황한 섬광이 반경 십여 장을 감싸 안고

findings.current: I didn’t miss the opening I hadn’t seen before—the one they’d exposed themselves.
findings.defect: Says Taekyung had failed to see the opening, although it had not existed visibly until the Black Ghosts exposed it by changing their attacks.
findings.rationale: 보이지 않던 describes the opening; 스스로 드러낸 identifies the Black Ghosts’ action.
findings.replacement: I didn’t miss the opening that had been invisible until they exposed it themselves.
findings.source: 보이지 않던 빈틈, 그러나 스스로 드러낸 그 빈틈을 나는 놓치지 않았다.

findings.current: They would have known that the tiny mistake they made while trying to capture me would lead directly to their deaths.
findings.defect: Attributes the Black Ghosts’ present mistake to the Three Elders of Tianshan.
findings.rationale: The elders are a hypothetical comparison; the Black Ghosts are the ones who have just diverted their weapons.
findings.replacement: They would have known that making even a tiny mistake like this to capture me would lead straight to their deaths.
findings.source: 나를 생포하기 위해 저지른 이 자그마한 실수가, 곧 그들의 죽음과 직결된다는 것을 알고 있었을 테니까.

findings.current: So I wasn’t the only monster standing here.
findings.defect: Reverses the comparison: Taekyung says the Black Ghosts are not the only monsters, not that he is not the only one.
findings.rationale: 놈들뿐만이 아니다 negates the Black Ghosts’ exclusivity and introduces Taekyung as another monster.
findings.replacement: So the Black Ghosts weren’t the only monsters standing here.
findings.source: 그렇기에 지금 이 순간, 이 자리에 존재하는 괴물은 놈들뿐만이 아니다.

findings.current: I tore off the hand still gripping its weapon
findings.defect: Changes the severed body part from the wrist to the hand.
findings.rationale: 손목 is the wrist; the weapon remains held by that severed part.
findings.replacement: I tore off its wrist, weapon still gripped in its hand,
findings.source: 병장기를 쥔 손목을 그대로 뽑아 버린 나는

summary: Several action details and one central comparison change the source meaning.
